source: docs/stories-50/cover-style-v3/OOC-COVERS.md (108 OOC covers, 12 web looks + 1 app look). v2 was 100% one look (OOC cluster 1, 17% of their shelf).
review: 2026-11-22 adversarial diversity review. Same-look pairs split: Starlit/System (both tsubaki3, dark, cyan glow) -> System is acid green + magenta glitch; Gilded/Melodrama (both crimson + candle gold glamour) -> Gilded is emerald + gold, Melodrama is cold blue-black rain + crimson; Holy/Cosy (both tsubaki2, light, pale warm) -> Holy is cool white/silver/sky blue, Cosy is rich amber; Sunlit/Thumbnail titles (both white heavy sans with a blue stroke) -> Sunlit is ink letters, white outline, yellow label.

v2 drift: Holy's navy scrim greyed the bottom half -> white bloom scrim and a deep-indigo script; Starlit's tracked kicker over one big serif line was the v2 lockup -> one-size stacked bracket title (maxLines 3, new in cover-title-v3.py).

Hard limits: dropped low-angle shots on Starlit (floating slit gown) and Sunlit (skirts in wind); dropped SDXL fanservice tags (shiny skin, bodysuit, leaning forward); Cosy names the trousers because Tsubaki.2 ignores negatives; no 'sheer'; no forbidden word in any appeal (appeal text may be copied into prompts). Too tame: Ink's turtleneck -> bare-shoulder halter; Cosy no longer 'muted'.

2026-11-22 owner, after the 8-story test: female leads should look hot. Every recipe now has femaleAppeal (prose, pose, SDXL tags) with deep necklines and clear cleavage, off-shoulder and bare-shoulder cuts, bare midriffs, thigh slits, fitted outfits and curvy adult figures; maleAppeal is the v3 male text, unchanged. SDXL recipes now take 'large breasts, cleavage' (cover-v3.mts allows them, still rejects huge/gigantic) and keep 'huge breasts, gigantic breasts' in the negative as a brake (bakeoff.png). Cameras that looked up a slit or down a loose neckline moved to eye level (Holy, Cosy). Hard limits unchanged and spelled out further below. Titles: Holy's script was too faint on pale art (bigger, darker, stroked, stronger halo); System Window's painted title came out 'CLeanup Crew', so it is typeset Orbitron capitals for every story.

2026-11-22 full-size review of the 50 finals: ink-and-one-red title font Sedgwick Ave Display -> Protest Revolution (OFL, dry brush, 3 px ink stroke; Sedgwick caps read SKILLS as ZKIhhZ). Eight covers whose recipe title spot landed on a face get a per-story placement in TITLE_OVERRIDES (cover-title-v3.py), not a recipe change.

canvas.note: Raw art is upscaled to this size (Lanczos, centre crop) before the title is set. Every px value under title and frame is at this size.

hardLimits: App Store 13+. Every character is clearly an adult: a mature face and figure, late twenties or older. Never childlike, never 'young-looking'.
No nudity, no nipples, no underwear or lingerie, no see-through clothing, no sexual poses.
No sexualised school uniforms. Academy stories get appeal from styling and expression: street clothes, a jacket with the crest, formal wear.
Say the limits positively in the prompt (the adult age, the clothes by name). Never name a forbidden thing in a positive prompt: SDXL tag models draw what they read.
The negative prompt always contains nsfw, nude and child. Tsubaki.2 standard ignores negative prompts, so for its recipes the positive wording carries every limit.

Every prompt states the age. SDXL: the tags 'mature female, adult' (or 'mature male, adult'). Prose: 'a woman in her late twenties with a mature face' (twenties or older, never younger). The negative always carries loli, child, teenager, young-looking, petite and aged down (baseNegative).
No underwear, lingerie or bikini as the outfit. Swimwear only when the story is set at a beach or a pool.

No sexual poses or acts: no lying-down come-ons, no spread legs, no upskirt, no from-below camera on a skirt or a slit, no leaning toward the camera to frame the chest, no camera looking down a loose neckline. Necklines are deep but the fabric is opaque and covers the chest.
A character the fixture makes under eighteen, or writes as a teenage student, gets none of femaleAppeal: age-appropriate clothes, no glamour, no figure-showing pose.

Inside these limits, female leads are hot (owner, 2026-11-22): deep necklines with clear cleavage, off-shoulder and bare-shoulder cuts, bare midriffs, thigh slits, fitted outfits, curvy adult figures, alluring confident expressions, poses that show the figure (hand on hip, arm raised behind the head, a look over a bare shoulder). Each recipe's femaleAppeal says how in its own look. Male leads are unchanged (maleAppeal).

quota.neighbours: On a shelf row, adjacent covers differ in value (light/mid/dark), dominant hue and title voice.

promptAssembly.tsubaki: Prose. Order: stylePrompt, then the subject sentence (name, 'a woman/man in her/his late twenties with a mature face and a full adult figure', hair, eyes, outfit from femaleAppeal.prose for a woman or maleAppeal for a man, adapted to the story), then composition.prompt with the pose replaced by femaleAppeal.pose for a woman, background, palette sentence, and for painted titles title.paintedPrompt with {TITLE} filled in (no recipe paints its title now). Tsubaki.2 standard ignores the negative, so every limit is said in the prose: 'opaque', what covers the chest, and the lower garment by name.
promptAssembly.sdxl: Tags first, prose after (cover-bakeoff.mts header). Order: stylePrompt tags, subject tags ('1girl' or '1boy' or '1girl, 1boy', 'solo' for one character, 'mature female' or 'mature male', 'adult', hair/eye tags), for a woman femaleAppeal.tags and then femaleAppeal.poseTags in place of composition.prompt (a man: outfit tags from maleAppeal, then composition.prompt), background tags, then one or two plain sentences naming the character and the scene (femaleAppeal.prose for a woman). Female leads take 'large breasts, cleavage'. Never 'huge breasts' or 'gigantic breasts' in the positive (cover-v3.mts rejects them): one 'cleavage' tag alone already ballooned the chest on Haruka v2 and Hoshino v2 (cover-style-v2/bakeoff.png), so every SDXL recipe keeps 'huge breasts, gigantic breasts' in its negative as a brake. Check the first draws for proportion.
promptAssembly.femaleLead: Not every story has a female lead. When the cover character is a woman, femaleAppeal replaces the outfit and the pose; framing and camera in femaleAppeal override composition where they are given. When there are two characters (Sunlit, Melodrama), each woman gets femaleAppeal and each man maleAppeal.
promptAssembly.negative: DEFAULT_NEGATIVE from infra/scripts/pixai.ts + baseNegative + the recipe's negativeExtra, minus anything in negativeDrop.

femaleAppeal.pose: Sitting sideways on the cushioned window seat at eye level, knees together and legs tucked to one side, a warm mug held at her lips in both hands, the bare shoulder turned toward the viewer, head tilted.
femaleAppeal.notes: Not prompt text. Seated and upright, never lying back. The mug sits at her lips, not against her chest, so the neckline shows.

recipes.maleAppeal: A male lead in a rolled-sleeve open-collar shirt and an apron, or a soft cardigan, forearms bare. Intimate but wholesome.
recipes.promptNotes: Not prompt text. Always name the lower garment (lounge shorts, lounge trousers, a long skirt, jeans) and say the knit covers her chest: Tsubaki.2 standard ignores the negative prompt, and an oversized sweater with nothing named below it tends to draw bare legs and no trousers.

title.extra: Handwritten brown ink on a torn, ruled notebook scrap held by a strip of pink washi tape, tilted 4 degrees, with small doodled hearts and stars.

recipes.name: Melodrama Red Accent
oocReferences: The Groom Who Was Replaced (wedding, white serif + red swash 'Replaced')
My Ex Fiancée Is My New Boss (pink accent words, title at the top)
recipes.stylePrompt: Cinematic painterly webnovel cover with dramatic film lighting, dark and glamorous: deep blue-black night shadows, a cold silver-blue key light from a rain-streaked window and a crimson rim light from behind, falling red rose petals and rain streaks catching the light, glossy wet highlights, shallow depth of field, rich contrast, a moody grade of blue-black, silver and crimson. Red appears only in the roses, the rim light, the lips or one red garment. Romantic tension, one frozen dramatic moment. The top quarter of the picture is plain dark shadow. No text, no letters, no logo anywhere in the image.
recipes.negativeExtra: bright, daylight, pastel, flat color, warm candlelight, gold, crowd, kissing, embrace from behind

composition.framing: waist-up, the two faces between 40% and 75% of the height
composition.pose: the lead in front facing the viewer with a determined or tearful-defiant gaze; the second character behind and to one side, half in shadow, a hand on the lead's shoulder or reaching and not quite touching
composition.titleSpace: top 28% dark and simple for the title at the TOP
composition.prompt: Two adults, waist-up and close together in the lower two-thirds of the picture: the lead in front, facing the viewer with a defiant, glistening gaze; behind and to one side the other, half in shadow, one hand resting on the lead's shoulder. The top quarter of the picture is empty dark shadow.

palette.light: Low-key and cold: a silver-blue key from a rain-streaked window on one side, a crimson rim from behind, rain glints. No warm candle gold (that is Gilded's palette).

recipes.background: A dark cathedral or wedding hall at night with rain running down the tall windows, or a rainy night street; scattered red roses and petals, out of focus.
recipes.appeal: Glamour and romantic tension, one frozen dramatic moment. Charged and romantic, never a sexual pose.

femaleAppeal.prose: A woman in her late twenties or thirties with a mature face and a curvy adult figure, in a bride's ivory satin gown or a deep red one, worn off both shoulders, with a deep plunging sweetheart neckline that shows clear cleavage and an opaque corseted bodice cinched tight at the waist; bare shoulders, arms and collarbones, a diamond pendant resting at the neckline, diamond earrings, red lips, a few wet strands of hair clinging to a bare shoulder.
femaleAppeal.pose: In front, her body turned three-quarters to the viewer, chin raised, one hand at her bare collarbone and the other holding a red rose at her hip; behind her, his hand rests on her bare shoulder.
femaleAppeal.notes: Not prompt text. Tsubaki.2 standard ignores the negative, so 'opaque corseted bodice' stays in the prose. No kissing, no embrace from behind.

recipes.maleAppeal: The other a tall adult in a black three-piece suit with the tie loosened.

title.extra: At the TOP: the opening words in white Playfair Display Italic flanked by thin rules, then the accent word(s) large in a crimson Great Vibes swash that tucks up under the white line, with a black halo to cut it out of the art (a crimson glow around crimson letters smeared the thin strokes). A title with no kicker is set in the swash alone.

recipes.name: Starlit Night
oocReferences: Constellation: The Ending War (starry cosmos, white serif in 《 》 brackets, thin rule)
recipes.stylePrompt: Luminous glossy gacha key art in deep space at night: glowing ultramarine, violet and rose-magenta nebula clouds, thousands of tiny stars, thin glowing constellation lines linking bright stars, a huge luminous pale moon filling a third of the sky behind the figure, swirling glowing stardust, cool cyan and silver rim light, crystalline sparkles. Saturated, luminous colour everywhere, never flat black or murky navy; dreamy, vast and fated. Nothing written anywhere: no text, no letters, no logo.
recipes.negativeExtra: warm colors, orange, daylight, interior, flat color, black background, from below, upskirt, multiple girls, multiple boys, crowd

composition.framing: full length at eye level; the figure spans 10% to 72% of the height, smaller than other recipes (head about 1/9 of the height), the moon behind the upper body
composition.pose: standing upright on a floating shard of starlight, body in a graceful S-curve, hair and the long skirt streaming sideways behind like a comet tail, one hand reaching up toward a bright star, a longing or serene look
composition.camera: eye level, from a little distance (not from below: a low angle on a floating gown is an upskirt risk)
composition.titleSpace: bottom 28% is star field and nebula for the title
composition.prompt: Full length at eye level, seen from a little distance: the adult lead stands upright on a floating shard of starlight in the upper two-thirds of the picture, in front of a huge glowing moon, body in a graceful S-curve, hair and the long ankle-length skirt streaming sideways behind like a comet tail, one hand reaching up toward a bright star. The bottom quarter is open star field and nebula.

palette.light: Cool starlight with a moon backlight; cyan rim light on hair and fabric.

recipes.background: A galaxy: nebula clouds, a dense star field, constellation lines, a giant moon or planet low on the horizon. Or a night rooftop under a meteor shower.
recipes.appeal: Statuesque, serene or longing, vast and fated.

femaleAppeal.prose: A statuesque woman in her late twenties with a mature face and a curvy, full adult figure, in a low-cut midnight-blue gown scattered with silver stars: a plunging neckline that shows clear cleavage, bare shoulders and arms, an opaque fitted bodice cinched at the waist, and a long flowing skirt with a high side slit that bares one leg to the thigh as the skirt streams sideways like a comet tail; long ribbons of starlight trail from her wrists.
femaleAppeal.pose: Standing upright on the floating shard, seen at eye level from a little distance, body in a graceful S-curve with one hip out and the slit leg stepping forward, one hand reaching up toward a bright star and the other at her hip, a longing, half-lidded look.
femaleAppeal.notes: Not prompt text. Camera stays at eye level: a slit gown in wind seen from below is an upskirt.

recipes.maleAppeal: A male lead in a long open dark coat with silver embroidery over a fitted shirt, collar open. Serene or longing.

title.extra: The whole title in Mincho capitals at one size, stacked on up to three balanced lines (maxLines 3) so the type stays big, held in 《 》 brackets (Constellation's lockup); white to ice-cyan with a cyan starlight glow; a thin rule with a four-point star below; a few sparkles. No small tracked kicker above a big word: that was exactly the v2 Cinzel lockup.

recipes.name: System Window
oocReferences: Reincarnated With an OP Skill (holographic SYSTEM window is the hook)
Your First Choice Changes Everything (choice cards, KEEP / REROLL)
WORLDLINE (neon green on black, HUD glyphs)
How to Live as a Vampire in 21st-Century Korea (viewfinder conceit)
recipes.stylePrompt: Glossy anime game key art built around a holographic game interface: crisp clean lineart, acid-green neon light with hot-magenta glitch accents, translucent glowing green interface windows with thin bright borders, stat bars, skill icons and hexagon grids floating in the air, faint scanlines and magenta-and-green chromatic-aberration glitch at the edges, green screen light reflecting on the face and hair. A deep green-black backdrop with a dim city or dungeon far behind. Sharp, techy, high contrast; acid green is the dominant colour, not blue. The interface windows show only bars, icons and grids: nothing written anywhere, no text, no letters, no logo.
recipes.negativeExtra: warm colors, daylight, painterly blur, blue theme, cyan theme, multiple girls, multiple boys, crowd

composition.framing: waist-up in the lower 65%; the top quarter dim green-black with only faint interface glow
composition.pose: three-quarter view, looking at the viewer with a smirk, one hand raised touching or swiping a floating panel
composition.titleSpace: the top 25% stays dim and quiet for the typeset SYSTEM panel (the title is no longer painted)
composition.prompt: Waist-up in the lower part of the picture, three-quarter view, looking at the viewer with a sly smirk, one hand raised and touching a small floating interface panel. The top quarter of the picture is dim green-black space with only faint interface glow and no window in it.

palette.light: Screen light: acid green from the interface windows in front, a hot-magenta glitch rim from behind. Green, not cyan: cool blue-cyan glow is Starlit Night's, on the same model.

recipes.background: Deep green-black space filled with translucent interface windows, stat bars, hexagon grids and skill icons; a dim city skyline or dungeon gate far behind.

femaleAppeal.prose: A sharp-featured woman in her late twenties with a mature face and a curvy, athletic adult figure: a fitted black cropped tactical top with the front zip pulled low to show cleavage, a bare toned midriff, a cropped black tech jacket worn open and slipping off one shoulder, fitted low-rise cargo trousers with a utility belt; a glowing earpiece, green screen light on glossy hair, a knowing smirk.
femaleAppeal.pose: Waist-up, three-quarter view, one hand on her hip and the other raised, swiping a floating interface panel; looking at the viewer with a sly smirk.

recipes.maleAppeal: A sharp-featured adult in their late twenties: a fitted black tech jacket worn open over a fitted shirt with the collar open, bare collarbone, a glowing earpiece, green screen light on glossy hair, a knowing smirk.

title.extra: Typeset for every story (2026-11-22): white Orbitron 900 capitals with a dark-green stroke and an acid-green glow, the whole title at one size on up to two balanced lines, inside a near-opaque dark-green SYSTEM panel with HUD brackets. It replaced the painted title because Tsubaki.3 painted 'CLeanup Crew' in mixed case on the test. The panel is 0.92 opaque so that an old raw that still has a painted window does not ghost through it. The kicker style is used only when --lines asks for a kicker.

paintedRetired.why: Tsubaki.3 set the painted title in odd mixed case ('CLeanup Crew, E-Rank') on story_cleanup_crew_e_rank. Not prompt text; kept for the record.
paintedRetired.paintedPrompt: Across the top third of the picture, one large holographic SYSTEM window with a glowing acid-green border; inside it the title "{TITLE}" in big bold white futuristic game-logo capitals with an acid-green glow, spelled exactly "{TITLE}". The small interface panels show only bars and icons, no other readable words.

frame.label: neon acid-green inset rule with viewfinder corners
